summary: The Glimmer Mole (calm: the Gem Mole), Crystal Cavern's recurring chaos mole: a 2x2 body sheet (chaos idle with swirly eyes and purple bubbles; burst kicking up pebbles and dust puffs; soothed seated adjusting its yellow helmet; calm proudly holding a faceted lavender crystal), drawn to the owner's critter concept sheet.
generationSource: Generated with Gemini from the owner's critter concept sheet and art-teacher's flat green body sheet reference.

edits.note: Rejected: soft crystal halos and translucent burst ribbon blended into the green key and the bandana varied across poses.

edits.prompt: 2x2 character sheet of an adorable plump taupe cartoon mole miner wearing a yellow hard hat with an ink-outlined faceted lavender amethyst crystal (no fuzzy glow halo) and a consistent coral-red triangular bandana across all four poses on pure flat green #00FF00.
edits.note: Kept as generated: crisp ink outlines, zero green halo, consistent bandana and scale across all four cells.

postProcessing.build: bun tools/art/build-person.ts crystal-mole --key=#00FF00 --height=330. Keys green, drops detached islands under 120 px, despills the alpha edge, scales chaos idle to 330 px, and adds the shared chaos aura.

measuredCentres.bodyCentreMethod: mean opaque-pixel centroid across the four generated body frames
